name: Kaminokawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kaminokawa town emblem in white: a stylised square device of concentric curved strokes enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kaminokawa, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1968.

features.role: Kaminokawa town emblem — a stylised square device of concentric curved strokes enclosing a ring
